name: AEGIS-Attention V6: Unified Hybrid Transformer Attention Module.
description: AEGIS-Attention V6: Unified Hybrid Transformer Attention Module.  Combines SVD low-rank factorized projections with LoRA adapters, sliding window attention, global linear kernel attention with adaptive spectral gating, and context fusion initialized to prioritize high-fidelity local attention. Hardened for multi-architecture deployment across DistilBERT, RoBERTa, GPT-2, and Qwen3.5.
math_latex: y = x (V \Sigma U^\top) + x (B^\top A^\top) + b

components.name: Factor U (Full-Rank Expansion Projection)
components.math_latex: y_t = z_t (\Sigma_r U_r^\top) + b, \quad U_r \in \mathbb{R}^{d_{out} \times r}

components.name: Residual LoRA / Norm Calibration
components.math_latex: \Delta y_t = x_t (B A)^\top \cdot \frac{\alpha}{r}, \quad A \in \mathbb{R}^{r \times d_{in}}, \; B \in \mathbb{R}^{d_{out} \times r}
